text:
Last Spring

		Take deep within you the little Chinese bell,
and when the lilac comes,
		blend this too
with your blood, your joy and your misery,
with the
		dark ground on which you depend.


Slow days. All things passed.
And you do not ask whether beginning or end,

		then perhaps the hours will carry you
still into June, with its
		roses.
Translated
		by Eustaquio Barjau

translation.title: Farewell
